series.label: Coffee and related HS0901 products · exports

sources.title: UN Comtrade public preview API
sources.note: World-partner reporting-country totals. Import/export movement does not establish final use.

limitations: This bounded pilot contains 21 selected HS product groups in 2024, with separate import/export queries. It is not a download of all commodities or every possible reporter.
These are reporter-country totals with the world as partner, not a complete bilateral network.
Imports may be processed, re-exported or stocked. Trade is not final consumption or a shipping route.
Values are current dollars; imports and exports may use different valuation bases. HS product forms differ. Missing reporters are not zero trade.
series.hosted_scope_note: All retained observations for this measure in the named built-in dataset. Native dates, reporting populations and unavailable/source-ineligible values remain unchanged.
